ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Welcome to today's exercise. Here is how to join, how to answer and send messages, and what to do if something goes wrong.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">First, the most important thing. This exercise tests the plan, not individuals.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Findings are reported at team level.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">To join, scan the code on the room screen with your phone's camera.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">On a laptop, or from somewhere else, open the join link you were sent.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Enter your details, choose Participant, tick the privacy box, and press Register.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Each inject appears on the room screen, and a voice usually reads it aloud.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">On your phone, the Inject tab shows the same message, the countdown, and your answer box.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">The Messages tab is for talking to the facilitator.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">On a laptop, the inject and your messages sit side by side.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Most injects need one answer per department, marked Group task.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Agree it together, and let one person type.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">If that person's phone is busy or gone, press Take over, and the text so far comes with you.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Some injects are marked Individual task.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Then everyone answers alone.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Press Submit answer before the time runs out.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Until then, you can press Edit answer to change it, and Submit changes to send it again.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Need more time? In Messages, tap We need a few more minutes, and press Send.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Or type your own message, and press Send.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Extra time, when given, is for everyone.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">The facilitator's messages appear at the top, with Reply and Got it.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Took a call, or locked your screen?</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Nothing is lost. The page catches up by itself.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">If your phone restarts, open the same link and press Continue on Welcome back.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Your typed text is still there.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">On a new phone or laptop, use the same name and department, and press Yes, continue as me.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Lost your page? Open the link again, or ask your room's Observer for the join code.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Use Do Not Disturb, not flight mode, and stay plugged in if you can.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">At the end, please answer the one-minute survey before you leave.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">To recap. Scan or open the link, one person types each answer, submit in time, and if you lose your page, open the link again.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Your facilitator will start the exercise shortly.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Welcome, and thank you for observing today.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Here is your role, your screen, notes, messages, and what to do if something goes wrong.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">You joined like everyone else, with the room screen's code or the join link, and chose Observer.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Remember: this exercise tests the plan, not individuals.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">You watch and take notes. You don't answer injects or guide the team, even when they are stuck.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">What you see becomes the report's evidence.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">On your phone or laptop, there are three tabs: Exercise, Notes and Messages.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Exercise shows what the room sees, what to watch for, and which departments have answered, but never what they wrote.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">To log a note, open Notes and tap the type: Positive, Needs improvement, or Critical gap.</prosody></voice></speak>
